title: Cross-functional roadmap sync prep — Apr 2026 (Asha scratchpad)
content:
Purpose: quick prep notes for cross-functional roadmap alignment sync (Product + Eng + Applied ML). Goal = make sure product priorities + model onboarding timeline + infra constraints are visible, capture open questions and follow-ups.

Participants: Maya (PM, hosted API), Raj (SRE/Infra), Dylan (Applied ML), Priya (Console), me (Asha, product ops).

Agenda (proposed, timeboxed):
- 5m: Quick status & wins (Q2 perf benchmarks, infra improvements)
- 15m: Model onboarding schedule (open-source models + Redwood-verified variants) — who owns each step
- 15m: Performance/latency risks — Dedicated vs Hosted tradeoffs, autoscale knobs
- 10m: Observability and evals — how we detect regressions, baseline prompts
- 10m: Action items and owners + follow-ups

Key points to surface:
- Model onboarding: Applied ML proposes 3 model candidates for hosted catalog in May (LlamaX-70B-fp16, OpenFast-30B-qt8, Redwood-12B-opt). Need infra readiness window: 2 weeks to validate kernels and quant paths. Who signs off on perf SLA for catalog? (Action: Dylan -> provide perf report by 2026-04-15)
- Dedicated capacity: Sales asking for guaranteed p95 latency of <120ms for 8k token avg. Current infra estimate: might need burst pools + hot-cache hints. Raj to confirm GPU pool sizing and cost delta (Action: Raj -> sizing + rough cost by 2026-04-12)
- Autoscaling policy: Product wants more aggressive burst for PLG users; SRE warns about cold-start + OOM. Proposal: tiered burst with concurrent request caps + pre-warm. Need to test with synthetic load. (Action: Raj + Eng infra -> run synthetic test, 2026-04-18)
- Observability: we lack a reliable regression signal for hallucination frequency post-quantization. Suggest creating a small eval harness (50 prompts) tied to alert if quality drops >5%. (Action: Dylan -> draft eval set + baseline, 2026-04-14)
- Rollouts: recommend canary rollout per model (5% -> 25% -> 100%) with automatic rollback on latency/quality thresholds. Product to define thresholds. (Action: Maya -> draft rollout policy doc, 2026-04-13)

Open questions / risks:
- Quality vs cost: quantized variants reduce cost but may regress on certain prompt families (code generation, math). Need category-specific evals.
- KV cache eviction behavior across long-running sessions — will impact interactive apps. Raj/infra to confirm current eviction heuristics. (Action: Raj -> doc evict behavior, 2026-04-12)
- Model compatibility: some community models have non-standard attention layers, might require kernel work. This increases onboarding time. (Action: Dylan -> flag any non-standard ops early)

Prep notes / talking points for meeting:
- Start with quick wins: p50 improved 30% for small models after kernel changes (call out PR#2314). Helps establish momentum.
- Emphasize measurable tradeoffs: show cost-per-token delta for quantized vs fp16 for the 3 candidate models (need numbers) — ask Applied ML to bring a table.
- Ask infra for clear SLO definitions for Dedicated vs Hosted; we should map feature flags/rollout options to those SLOs.

Draft ask list (what I want from each partner):
- Maya: agree on rollout thresholds + product priority order for model support
- Dylan: perf reports + eval set + list of model ops that may need kernel changes
- Raj: infra sizing + eviction doc + planned maintenance windows for onboarding work
- Priya: console changes needed for canary controls + visibility into per-customer routing

Follow-ups to create after meeting:
- Roadmap update PR (me) — include tasks, owners, dates, linked tickets
- Jira epic: Model-Onboarding-Q2-2026 (create sub-tasks for kernel work, perf validation, docs)
- Small eval harness repo (Dylan) — invite Eng and Product reviewers

Quick scratch calculations (fill in during meeting):
- Cost delta example: LlamaX-70B-fp16 = $0.12/token? (placeholder) vs Redwood-12B-opt-qt8 = $0.04/token — need accurate unit cost from infra billing.
- Expected validation window per model = perf test (2d) + stability (5d) + docs (1d) = ~8 business days

Notes-to-self (rambling):
- Keep the conversation concrete — avoid rehashing roadmap goals. Focus on owners + dates.
- If infra says onboarding is longer than 2 weeks, propose deprioritizing lower-impact models.
- Make sure we have rollback plan and runbook before any canary reaches >25%.

Possible friction points to watch:
- Eng capacity: release-engineering vs serving-runtime availability this sprint. Might need to shift kernel work to next sprint.
- Sales commitments vs realistic SLAs — don’t overpromise; ask Sales to sync with Engineering directly if they need firm numbers.

End-of-note: will tidy and create meeting agenda for calendar invite. Keep this doc as scratch—will copy finalized agenda to calendar and to confluence after meeting.
